source_quote: The College of Engineering/ECE Department offers a minor in Artificial Intelligence (AI).
answer: The ECE Department's Artificial Intelligence minor meets demand for experts in AI, knowledge representation, data mining, machine learning and automated reasoning; it aims to give advanced AI expertise, prepare students to apply AI in industry, and prepare them for graduate studies.

source_quote: Use current techniques, architectures, and tools to build intelligent systems.
answer: AI minor graduates can build intelligent systems with current tools, design tools to evaluate intelligent systems, and apply AI to improve existing non-AI systems.

source_quote: While most relevant to students in Computer and Communications Engineering and
answer: The AI minor is most relevant to CCE and Computer Science students but is also offered to RHU BE or MS students in other engineering and CS disciplines, and case by case to BS/BE holders from other universities; students declare it early in their major.

answer: To complete the AI minor: submit the Minor Declaration Form, get approval from the student's college dean and the College of Engineering dean, keep a minor CGPA of at least 70%, and complete 18 credits; overlapping courses count, but at least 3 credits must not count toward the major or another minor.

source_quote: computer networks, environmental engineering, energy, smart cities, autonomous
answer: AI minor holders can work in communications, computers and networks, environmental engineering, energy, smart cities, autonomous vehicles, biomedical engineering, health, security, biology and physics.

answer: The AI minor is 18 credits. Mandatory courses listed: CCEE 460 Artificial Intelligence and CCEE 564 Machine Learning and Data Mining. Electives are chosen from CCEE 516, 536, 561, 566, 567, 568 and 612.
review_note: Text says two mandatory and four electives, then 'three mandatory courses (9 credits)' listing only two, and 'three elective courses (9 credits)'; the number of electives is inconsistent.

answer: In the AI minor section, CCEE 563 Robotics is listed as equivalent to MECA 544 with no prerequisite.
